name: Chicken Gun Zombie
desc:
Inspired by the mobile game "Chicken Gun"

Play to obtain rewarding badges! You get to customize your character, build, spawn NPCs, and fight with players!

[Changelog]
- Halloween Update!
- Made the Map in Halloween Theme.
- Updated the Music to a Halloween Theme.
- Added 1 new free Weapons.
- Added 2 new Badge Weapons.
- Added 3 new Event Weapons.
- Added 16 new Badge accessories.
- Added 12 new Event accessories.
- Added 3 new Badge NPCs.
- Added 3 new Event NPCs.
- Added 2 new Badge Buildings.
- Weapon balance changes.
- Updated few NPCs.
- Updated few Buildings.
- Updated various of Weapons tool icon and description.
- Added Custom Player Animations.
- Added a Mobile support for range Weapons.

[Update Information]
Chicken Gun Zombie is its own standalone game. 'Chicken Gun - Roblox' is another game. Check it in our official group.

Report bugs in the official group!
